title: Strengthen recovery-priority refusal tests with exact API error status and unfinished-attempt cause
outcome: Recovery-priority negative controls distinguish the intended invalid-gap, readKey-conflict and unfinished-attempt refusals from unrelated failures.
acceptance: Tests assert HTTP400 for criterion0 and out-of-range gaps, HTTP409 for a reused readKey with changed intent, and HTTP409 plus the unfinished-attempt cause for submission after a failed proof read.
Focused behavioral coverage passes without using instruction or brief prose assertions.
